title: Aromatic Spicy Mexican Poblanos Frijoles Charros
description: Spicy Mexican dish featuring roasted poblanos and charros beans, served in a dolsot stone bowl, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to roast the poblano peppers
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for 30 minutes, then peel and chop them
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and cook the ground beef until browned
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the charros beans, apple juice, and chopped poblano peppers, and bring to a simmer
Reduce heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes
Meanwhile, toast the cubed double rise bread in the oven for 5 minutes
To serve, place the bean and pepper mixture in a dolsot stone bowl and top with toasted bread
